subject: Requesting clarification on observed 503 window and SLO exception
body:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@novacorp.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: support@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Brief outage impact - need confirmation of SLO window and credit eligibility

Hi Rohan,

We observed a spike of 503s affecting our checkout path between ~08:14 and 08:28 PDT (us-west-2). Traffic dropped by >90% for several minutes and retries started to cascade in our frontend. We captured error samples and session ids; attaching a short extract.

Can you confirm whether this maps to any Redwood-hosted routing/failure event and whether it would qualify for SLO remediation (credit) under our agreement? We're in the middle of renewal discussions and need a clear eligibility determination.

Helpful details:
- Region: us-west-2 (Phoenix AZ region)
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (token generation)
- Client request IDs: in attached session-ids-list.csv
- Error pattern: 503s then 429s on retries

Thanks — we appreciate an expedited look.

Sanjay
Ops Manager, NovaCorp

--- attachment: novacorp-error-samples-0929-0930.txt (text/plain, 8 KB)

-----Original Message-----

From: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief outage impact - need confirmation of SLO window and credit eligibility

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the detail and the samples. CCing Marissa (account lead) and Karthik (SRE) to pull logs and validate the exact window. A couple quick asks to speed investigation:

- Can you confirm whether NovaCorp was routing to Redwood Hosted API or a Dedicated pool at the time?
- If you have any trace IDs from your frontend traces (x-request-id), include one or two — that helps map to token-level logs.

Our side will:
- Pull infra metrics and request traces for 08:10–08:40 PDT across your customer shard.
- Return a preliminary confirmation inside 4 business hours and an eligibility assessment within 24 hours.

If this looks like a platform-side availability window we will include the candidate downtime window and the calculation method we use for credits.

— Rohan
Senior Account Mgmt, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai

-----On Thu, Sep 30, 2027 at 09:28 AM Sanjay Patel <sanjay@novacorp.com> wrote:-----
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@novacorp.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:28:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief outage impact - need confirmation of SLO window and credit eligibility

Thanks, Rohan.

We are on Redwood Hosted API (no dedicated pool). Including a couple example x-request-ids in the CSV. Also attaching a gzipped excerpt of our backend error logs that show repeat 503 responses from the SDK for several minutes. Our retries were client-driven. Renewal is in two weeks — visibility here matters.

Attaching: preliminary-log-excerpt.gz

Sanjay

-----Original Message-----
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@novacorp.com>
Cc: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief outage impact - need confirmation of SLO window and credit eligibility

Hi Sanjay — Marissa from Redwood here, thanks for the quick report and the attachments. We appreciate the heads up and understand the renewal timing. I'm escalating this for priority handling.

Preliminary notes from our side:
- We see elevated error rates on the host shard that serves NovaCorp between 08:13:40 and 08:26:50 PDT. This aligns with the window you reported.
- Root-cause work is underway (routing handoff spike during a transient scheduling disruption).
- Candidate downtime window we will propose for SLO consideration: 2027-09-30T15:13:40Z to 2027-09-30T15:26:50Z (UTC conversion).

Next steps and ask:
1) Please confirm we have permission to ingest the gzipped log excerpt into our SRE incident bucket for full correlation (this will include matching your x-request-ids to our distributed traces).
2) We will produce a short incident summary and an eligibility calc for any service credits within 24 hours. If eligible, the credit calculation will follow section 3.4 of the SLA (pro-rata of monthly invoice for impacted minutes).
3) We plan to deliver a postmortem draft within 72 hours and a remediation timeline outlining preventive changes (e.g., scheduler guardrails and improved warm pools for the affected region).

If you want an immediate call, we can schedule a 30-minute bridge with SRE in the next hour. Otherwise we'll proceed with the log ingest upon permission and come back with the preliminary credit eligibility.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
